content.short: Safe is a smart contract wallet that requires a minimum number of approvals to confirm a transaction.
content.description: Safe is a smart contract wallet that lets you define a list of owner accounts and a quorum required to approve a transaction. Its open source protocol and SDKs underpin Account Abstraction capabilities such as Sponsored Transactions, account recovery, transaction batching, fraud monitoring, and configurable spending policies. By design, it supports multi-signature control and modular features across supported networks, enabling resilient authorization flows, recoverability, and scalable governance for multi-user wallets.
content.meta: Safe is a smart contract wallet with a list of owners and a quorum to approve transactions. Discover Safe and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: How Email Login Works Without Breaking Self-Custody
resources.tldr: A plain account of what is stored and what is not: assets stay controlled by signer keys and the Safe contract, never by an email address.

resources.title: Security Hub: Catching Misconfiguration Early
resources.tldr: Most teams learn about a stale signer or a wrong threshold only after it costs them. Read-only checks that surface it beforehand.
